task: In Production only, change the traffic split of the multivariate flag "wishlist_sync_copy" so the "Try it free" variation gets 70% of users and the rest stay on the control value. Development keeps its current split.
finalText: DONE: In Production, "Try it free" (variant key `b`) on `wishlist_sync_copy` is now at 70%, with the control value "Start free trial" covering the remaining 30%. Development is still at 50%.
